messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: blavaan 0.4-6
parts:
blavaan 0.4-6 is now on CRAN. There are new speedups, especially for models with complete, continuous data. For models that do not need meanstructure, you are also allowed to specify sample.cov and sample.nobs in place of the raw data.

Ed
